issues.title: Al-Zouba: Yemen stands in solidarity against any attack on Jordan’s sovereignty
issues.title_en: Al-Zouba: Yemen stands in solidarity against any attack on Jordan’s sovereignty
issues.summary: Amman — Yemen’s Minister of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates Dr. Afrah Abdulaziz Al-Zouba expressed her country’s solidarity against any attack on Jordan’s sovereignty, regardless of the party responsible.
